name: Proton Mail Bridge
description: Packaged Proton Bridge login, generated password and IMAP/SMTP settings
author: spotty
help:
Optional Proton Mail Bridge

Click Install in the Store to enable the proton trigger and open the packaged login window. The native Linux x86_64 package includes Proton Bridge: no separate Bridge installation is needed. Enter your username and account password in the window. Two-factor, mailbox password and security-key prompts appear when needed. Never type credentials in the search bar.

After successful sign-in the window displays the generated Bridge password, mail username and local IMAP/SMTP host, ports and TLS settings. Copy these into your mail client. Use Mail settings under Saved accounts to view them again.

Type proton login, proton settings or just proton to reopen the window. Close and keep Bridge running leaves mail connected. Open Bridge at desktop login controls reconnection on desktop login. Uninstalling the trigger does not sign out or stop Bridge.

Requires a paid Proton Mail plan and a working unlocked Linux keyring. Only one login frontend can be open at a time. Human verification can be completed in the included official Bridge GUI. The runtime is activated in your private user data folder only after you opt in; no system packages are installed.

Requires a Spotty build containing the bundled Bridge integration. Older versions show this native trigger as unavailable; rebuild with Cargo and current submodules.
